name: parent_unknown_is_not_a_root
note: an UNKNOWN parent rides its own field and never becomes an absent parent_id. Absence means 'begins a prefix chain', which the aggregator treats as vacuously proven and therefore contributing -- so collapsing unknown into absent would fabricate roots and inflate residual mass. Arises when a stored run has blocks skipped (sliding-window, Mamba), where list order stops implying parenthood
